title: Wire the first HVA draft sidecar UI
goal: Add a narrow HVA workbook inspector surface that reads approved/draft sidecar state through the local service and writes draft state only.
acceptance_criteria: The app shows a workbook inspector tab for the first workbook discovered in the full EPP workspace
The inspector reads approved workbook sidecar state from the local service
The inspector reads draft workbook sidecar state when present
The inspector writes local draft workbook sidecar state through the service
Approved state remains visibly locked and is not written by the UI
non_goals: Replacing the seed document reader with the full EPP reader
validation: Run service smoke for HVA approved read and draft write
notes: This is intentionally a small UI proof over the workbook service boundary. The fuller HVA workbook remains SG-0008.
